messages:
Nora G.: dropped two sketches for the alert rule card focusing on channel order + quiet-hours visibility. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz-alert-preview. main question: can users tell delivery order, suppressed channels, and thresholds at a glance in a dense list? Luis F.: nice work. main concern: the compact list hides threshold numbers behind hover. tooltips are not reliable for keyboard/sr. propose a tiny inline summary chip: 'CRIT 90% • 5m' visible next to the channel label. keeps density but shows key data. Mina Q.: agree on inline chips. also the overflow badge that shows '+3' should communicate suppression vs lower priority. suggestion: '+3 (1 suppressed)' or expose the next-in-line and mark suppressed ones with a ghost icon + label. Nora G.: good call. on microcopy I'm testing 'Quiet hours (suppression window)' instead of 'Silence window' 1 feels clearer in user tests. any objections? Tom (product): +1 to combined label. less jargon for new users. also want a concise preview sentence for SR when rule changes: 'Preview: triggers at 90% for 5 minutes; notifies PagerDuty then Slack; email suppressed midnight-6am local.' Keep it short so screenreaders don't repeat long paragraphs. accessibility-bot: automated scan findings: 1) small chips contrast at 3.2:1 (fail) 1 raise to >=4.5:1 for small text. 2) drag handles not keyboard focusable 1 add tabindex=0 and visible focus style. 3) preview update lacks role="status" on aria-live region 1 recommend
Preview...
. Luis F.: implementation notes: timeline pill idea (48px bar) is good. must include patterned fill (stripes) for suppressed ranges for non-color users. provide fallback text and aria-describedby id: 'suppression-desc'. Mina Q.: SR snippet proposal: ```html
Preview: triggers at 90% for 5 minutes; PagerDuty then Slack.
Email suppressed between 12:00 AM and 6:00 AM local time.
``` Luis F.: also recommend an undo snackbar anchored near the preview on inline edits: 'Threshold set to 85% — Undo' with role="alert" and keyboard focusable undo button. reduces fear of accidental changes. Nora G.: will update Figma to: inline chips, overflow label with suppressed count, timeline pill with stripes + text fallback, aria-live role=status, tabindex for handles, and undo snackbar. aiming to post an interactive prototype by EOD tomorrow for quick SRE+support tests. Tom (product): perfect. I'll schedule 4 short validation sessions once prototype is up. thanks folks. :thumbsup:
